card.name: The word up after end or wind
card.fires_on: The word "up" right after a verb like end, wind, sign, show, team or grow, forming a phrasal verb. It is strongest for "end up" and "wind up" before a result.

modes.example: he teamed<< up>> with a waffle vendor who rolled his
